title: The Seed Paper on the Damp Towel
youtube_title: The Seed Paper on the Damp Towel | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a small thing finish its quiet work.
summary: At a bakery kitchen where dough and jam are left to finish, Brisa wants to check on a sheet of seed paper on a damp towel before it is ready. With Mama nearby, Brisa leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
